text: Objective 7 progress bar text clipped on the left: shows 'nbers 5/10 · Buildings 0/2' instead of 'Members 5/10'; the wide label overflows the bar

After clicking 'Feed Residents (1 hungry)' the command bar reflowed: the same spot now holds 'Talk to Bob Roberts (Stranger) - Glutton'. A second click (double-click, or retry on a slow frame) would start a conversation instead. Inventory panel also floats mid-screen over the 3D view when inside a settlement, and Season panel overlaps Player Info.

Chronicle at tick 193752: 'After a siege, a camp of Southernfield fell to Castleport.' then 'Southernfield is no more; it never raised so much as a hut.' Southernfield had a settlement (Grace Lewis raised it at tick 183600) that was just captured, so the epitaph contradicts the line above it.

Objective 8 'Sell resources at market' cannot be done: Sell Resources says 'No merchant here can pay: the richest has 2 coins, and your cheapest good (stone) sells for 3.' Market Info shows 4/4 stalls with 3 coins total. Player has 361 coins, merchants are broke in winter, so the tutorial objective stalls with no hint how to unblock (e.g. buy from them first, or wait). Also a world-space 'Newwood Caravan' label draws over the Era panel top-left.

Hunger warning and Feed button disagree: banner 'Fortton: 6 members hungry' while button reads 'Feed Residents (5 hungry)'. Earlier (tick 193568) the banner said '1 member hungry' and Feed fed 2. Presumably banner counts all members anywhere vs residents standing here, but nothing on screen says so; a player cannot tell who is missing or where.

Build House shows no cost anywhere: button just says 'Build House', confirm says 'Click again to confirm: Build House.' It cost 20 wood + 15 stone (inventory 160/26 -> 140/11 at tick 212291). Settlement Info only lists 'Next (K): Farm, 25 wood, 10 stone'. Player cannot plan a house before clicking.

Feed button shows 'Feed Residents (1 hungry)' but the yellow 'members hungry' banner is gone (tick ~231300, first night of spring). Elsewhere banner showed more hungry than the button; the two indicators never agree.

Balance: Feed Residents is a near-constant chore. In one winter day (tick 189456-232000) Feed Residents was used 19 times for ~95 resident-feedings, 4-10 newly hungry every ~2500 ticks (50 game s) in a 13-member town. Trees still drop 1-3 apples each in winter so it is sustainable, but the loop is walk-chop-teleport-feed every minute; residents never feed themselves from my 260+ stockpile or the market.

World event 'Wanderers at the gate' option 3 description has a large gap mid-sentence: 'they stay in these lands with no nation    and may found one of their own.' (looks like a missing em dash glyph or a dropped word).

World-space labels scale huge with camera distance and render over HUD: settlement label 'N here, 17/24 residents' fills the top of the screen behind the Chronicle/status panels in every settlement shot, and a nearby pawn label ('Quinn Smith / Greedy / (doing nothing)') covers the Market Info panel at right.
